question: Which parent-preserving changes to the algebraic structure of P0554 most affect galaxies, radial cluster lensing, raw image topology, and Solar bounds?

residence_softness.concept: soft-min shape joining radial accumulation to its apogee

screen_softness.concept: midpoint-preserving shape of the high-acceleration screen

potential_softness.concept: midpoint-preserving addition of potential depth to unity

potential_path_cross.concept: cross term between potential depth and path history

response_addition_softness.concept: generalized addition of the new dynamical channel to baryonic gravity

lensing_addition_softness.concept: generalized addition of the new lensing channel to baryonic GR

extent_scale_coupling.concept: baryonic extent moves the accumulation radius instead of its amplitude

potential_scale_coupling.concept: potential depth moves the accumulation radius as well as amplitude

mass_growth_power.concept: enclosed baryonic mass growth supplies an additional profile-shape factor

operator_definitions.generalized_screen: S_k(y)=[1+(2^k-1)y^(nk)]^(-1/k), preserving S(1)=1/2 and the high-field power y^-n.
operator_definitions.generalized_residence: C_k=(C_open^-k+C_apogee^-k)^(-1/k), with k=1 equal to the P0554 rational saturation.
operator_definitions.potential_path_cross: I=P+R-1+k_cross(P-1)(R-1), with k_cross=1 equal to P*R.
operator_definitions.extent_scale: r_s receives E^eta rather than changing scalar amplitude.
operator_definitions.potential_scale: r_s receives P^eta in addition to the inherited potential-amplitude factor.
operator_definitions.mass_growth: I receives [1+max(d ln M_b/d ln r,0)]^eta.

evaluation.universal_q_rule: Keep the P0554 universal q fixed for every structural variant.
evaluation.galaxy: 131 SPARC galaxies with fixed nuisance parameters and untouched outer-radius predictions.
evaluation.derived_cluster: 84 CLASH equivalent-acceleration points in 20 systems with no per-cluster adjustment.
evaluation.raw: RX J2129 plus four Caminha/CLASH clusters at frozen P0554 geometries; profile source positions and solve exact held-out roots.
evaluation.solar: Same analytic Cassini, Earth, Saturn, and Mercury proxies as P0554.

analysis_rules.raw_common_system_rule: A raw slope uses only systems complete for -u, baseline, and +u; root changes are separate.
analysis_rules.stable_direction_rule: At least three finite step sizes, at least 75 percent sign agreement, and median absolute normalized slope at least 0.02.

claim_limits: These algebraic deformations are phenomenological operators, not equations derived from an action.
The parent and all systems are spent exploratory data.
Fixed ordinary lens geometry isolates structural field response but is not a predictive geometry refit.
Solar diagnostics are analytic proxies rather than an ephemeris likelihood.
A raw root change is a topology observation, not an accuracy improvement.
